name: small-business-order-manager
description: AI-powered order management for small businesses, built on the Gemini API

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n db,server,web -c green,blue,magenta "npm run db:start -w server" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run test:unit -w server
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate -w server
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.db:reset: npm run build:shared && npm run db:reset -w server
scripts.db:status: npm run build:shared && npm run db:status -w server
scripts.db:check: npm run build:shared && npm run db:check -w server
scripts.dev:app: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
